definition_file.title: Definition File
definition_file.description: The node's list of maps, as init.lua's header names it (mapping/datamap.lua).

mapping.title: Mapping
mapping.description: The text of mapping/init.lua, the file the Map view sits on.

files.title: Files
files.description: The node's Lua files as they are now, by path: mapping/datamap.lua, premap.lua, postmap.lua, custom.lua, mapping/maps/*, mapping/helpers/* - and main.lua, which is checked for reading its input through mapping/init.lua. Others are ignored.

source_schema.title: Source Schema
source_schema.description: source.json, or null when it is missing or unreadable.

target_schema.title: Target Schema
target_schema.description: target.json, or null when it is missing or unreadable. No map is turned into code without it: it orders each resource's elements (or, for a node building HL7 v2, the output's segments).
